audit.limits: Custom command matches are lexical, including data and dormant code; review before transfer. Embedded helper presence does not prove invocation resolution. PATH tools, dynamic commands, transitive third-party dependencies, repositories, theme assets and effective configuration require further proof. Whole-line provenance comments/licenses/tests/docs are excluded; inline comments and compatibility data may need review.

pendingRequirements.proof: Aggregation implemented; collect and pass all nine tuple-bound checks. Partial compiled/QML and static inventory do not replace effective runtime, network, migration, native or physical proof
All retained actions, conditions and provider-generated calls resolve from declared packages, including transitive helpers
Owned default theme/background, icon and text fonts render today's desktop without inherited assets or pre-existing XDG state
Packaged fresh-host compositor/session/keybinding defaults; consumer contributes only selections and machine values
Renamed native registrations and helpers with actual extension permissions and copy/download tests
Independent editor integration with preserved user data
Inspected system settings/services/hooks classified and required behavior delivered by pinned native packages
Exact third-party sources, recipes, signatures and channels recorded; no inherited repository/server required
Actual clean Arch installation, login/workflows, blocked inherited domains, update and rollback with exact artifact identities

audit.scope: Static package-output inventory; not clean-host acceptance

limits: The browser, authorization, runtime and installed browser recovery checks bind to the committed outputs. Portal workflow observations precede the final generation. Formal tuple-bound gate acceptance, physical cases, native recovery and the reference Test kit remain open.
